label: Structured shared-IO feature process - production59 primitive-consistent causal rollout - every repeated numbered GNGLU replaced by H64 dual-state gated exchange memory - layer 8 causal self-attention Q/K/V/O256 - K1 4x1s input x 59 - K2 16x1s primitive output x 17 rederived to 59 - balanced 50% return / 25% other derived / 25% direct primitive MSE - minute primitives boundary-masked - W256 M128 P128 F128 PF256 NF256 - 256k clean - batch 1536 train/evaluation - no regularization - EMA 4

recurrentMemory.stateInitialization: zero per layer at the start of every example sequence
recurrentMemory.cell: separate W_hv/W_hg/W_v/W_g projections, GN normalization, independently learned candidate/gate affines, product exchange gates, and separately learned H-to-V/V-to-H exchange maps

layer8Attention.causality: output step s attends only to generated NF states <=s

architecture.numberedLayerSharing: each numbered layer is one exact shared module; all repeated numbered GNGLU layers carry their own H64 state while layer 8 remains one shared causal attention operator
architecture.outputState: layer 7 produces NF with recurrent hidden memory; causal layer-8 attention maps the generated NF prefix to expected W; memory-bearing layer 2 decodes W to 17 primitive coordinates; differentiable code reconstructs all 59 output channels
architecture.baseConsistency: BTC one-second candle geometry, return activity, aggregate trade flow, aggressor side, spot volume, completed futures-minute state, and ETH minute return are decoded once; every affected production channel is derived from the same predicted primitive history

loss.description: 50% standardized 16-step return MSE, 25% standardized MSE over the other 58 derived channels, and 25% standardized direct primitive-coordinate MSE; minute coordinates are supervised only at minute completion

sampling.description: the original production59 dense chronological nonzero-target population with four observed rows and sixteen future rows per origin
sampling.comparisonControl: the balanced production59 attention model is restored; latent widths, primitive-consistent outputs, data loss, optimizer, examples, and EMA are retained while K1 grows 2 to 4, K2 grows 2 to 16, and every recurrent numbered layer gains H64 private memory

evaluation.headline: step-1 next completed 1s signed log return
evaluation.comparableMetrics: headline step-1 return metrics remain comparable to prior structured production59 runs; all sixteen per-step rows are persisted

alignment.input: four consecutive production59 rows ending at each control origin
alignment.target: sixteen complete chronological production59 rows at origin+1 through origin+16
alignment.causalDerivation: only predicted primitive coordinates and observed history through the origin enter changing future channels; each predicted step updates rolling state before the next
alignment.memoryCausality: each layer's H64 state consumes only its own earlier calls within the current example; all memories reset before the next example sequence
alignment.attentionCausality: the step-s attention query sees only generated NF keys/values at steps <=s
